cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pick a Priority
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parents' gravy needs stirring and you need a lift. Choose which job I'm doing; sauce doesn't pause politely when I leave.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you put dinner on a timer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A timer measures time. It does not stir. Gravy or station, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Gravy. I'll get a taxi. Just bring my suitcase downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose again: suitcase or smooth gravy. I need one instruction that doesn't require me to leave the other one unattended.

reason: Preserve the strong original timer and taxi causality, removing wrappers so exact culinary correction itself forces the priority choice.
